title: review-report.json (code-review pipeline RV1-RV8 + RV7b output; local .agents/state/ or CI artifact)

signals.description: collected by RV1 for later stages

public_api_change.description: skipped when the agentive manifest has no paths.public_api

inline_suppressions.description: added suppression lines (advisory checklist for RV5)

incident_history_90d.description: revert or hotfix on a touched file within 90 days

recent_churn_30d.description: a touched file changed within 30 days

chain.description: artifact-chain order check (decisions.accepted CHAIN; rules in pr-body-agentive-review.schema.json x-agentive-chain). Computed by RV1 from the diff, the base tree and agentive-review.chain; RV8 blocks on chain_order (profile ci); the precommit profile reports only

confirm_scope_hits.description: RV2.confirm_scope: changed paths that match agentive-review-rules.trust_boundary.confirm_scope_globs (U2 confirm_scope categories)

llm_valid.description: false -> the LLM layer output was invalid and the PR goes to a human

raised_by_llm.description: RV4.raise: the raise-only check moved the tier to 2 (reason llm_raise)

findings.description: RV6 output (merged, deduped, ranked); RV7 fills verification

rv7b.description: RV7b risk score (U6 agentive:rubric@1); computed only, never compared with the threshold here

reason_codes.description: the same decision as reason codes (optional; $defs.gate_reason); every code the gate rules name

u1_value.description: decisions.U1 read at gate time (user decided C on 2026-10-14; A/B allowed as project override)

check_conclusion.description: never neutral. block -> failure; human_required -> success with auto_merge false (the directing human merges, P3); pass -> success

auto_merge.description: true -> gate runs gh pr merge --auto

demoted.description: U1.c: a demotion issue is open for this PR's tier and source

shadow_would_auto_merge.description: tier 1 in shadow mode: the gate would have auto-merged (label agentive:shadow-auto-merge)

count.description: auto-merged PRs of this tier and source reverted or hotfixed within 7 days, counted after the latest close of a demotion issue for this scope

gate_only.description: conditions that block auto-merge without raising the tier

head_sha.description: the decision is bound to this head (P4)

explainer.description: tier-2 ## Explainer presence check (decisions.accepted EXPLAIN, revised 2026-10-27: presence only; rules in pr-body-agentive-review.schema.json x-agentive-body-headings.tier2_explainer). Mermaid syntax and code refs are not checked; retired fields: head_refs, unresolved_refs; retired problem code: no_head_code_ref

required.description: true exactly when RV4 assigned tier 2

next_action.description: message shown in the check summary, e.g. run /pr --explain

trigger.description: event that ran this gate decision; edited and pull_request_review_comment (an agentive-reply line) re-run the gate without a new review round. pull_request_review is not a trigger (retired 2026-10-27, F-08: the gate does not run on a review submission)

present.description: the presence check, one boolean per rule: ## Explainer exists, is the first level-2 heading, has ### Before and ### After (in this order), and each holds a ```mermaid block

allOf.description: explainer_missing blocks: decision block (check failure) with reason explainer_missing

u2.description: U2 final confirmation record (decision U2=B and U2.non_interactive, user 2026-10-14). human_confirmation obtained only when a human answered the confirmation in the run that made the change; a missing record counts as not_obtained.

run.description: unknown: CI cannot tell how the change was made (no official signal separates claude -p in a hook, UV-12); treated like non_interactive unless a human confirmation is recorded

action.description: pr_only_tier2: no direct commit to the default branch and no merge; PR only, tier 2

round.description: 1 = first review of the PR; +1 per new reviewed head

mode.description: round 1 and an explicit agentive:full-review request are full; later rounds review only the diff since the last reviewed head plus open findings

method.description: execution (a reproducing test or shell command) first, otherwise a different-model verifier

reviewers.description: kept after dedupe so one axis does not mask another

trigger.description: the condition under which the defect shows (required with file:line)

bug_class.description: one finding names every instance of the pattern

shadow.description: from a shadow reviewer: never blocking

source.description: reply_line = an agentive-reply line from an author with write access; next_round = the finding did not recur in the next round (the only way fixed is confirmed); inferred = a reason inferred at read time from a plain reply, tagged [inferred]

comment_id.description: REST id of the reply comment that holds the agentive-reply line

allOf.description: only important findings can block (F1f)
shadow reviewer findings never block

gate_reason.description: machine-readable reason codes of the RV8 decision (F-24, 2026-10-27): failing_required_check and unanswered_finding (block), U2.non_interactive (human_required, RV4.u2_non_interactive), explainer_missing and chain_order (block), tier2, trust_boundary (RV2 hit), always_human, chain_approval, llm_raise (RV4 raise-only check), critical_cve_unchecked, inconclusive_finding, finding_disputed, review_rounds_exceeded, pending_verbs (human_required), shadow, tier1_off, rubric_invalid, score_above_threshold, demoted (tier 1 or the kill switch keeps auto-merge off), gate_only (a gate-only condition), coverage_unavailable (the coverage gate was skipped), u1_policy (U1=A or B keeps auto-merge off). reasons[] stays free text for people

allOf.description: tier 2 never auto-merges
U1=A: nothing auto-merges
U1=B: tier 1 never auto-merges
U1=C conditions a, c, d: tier 1 auto-merge needs a computed RV7b score, tier1 mode on and no demotion (score <= human_if_score_gt is checked by RV8; JSON Schema cannot compare two fields)
no confirm_scope hit -> nothing to confirm
confirm_scope hit -> human_confirmation is obtained or not_obtained
U2.non_interactive: confirm_scope hit without human confirmation -> PR only, tier 2 (reason U2.non_interactive)
action commit when a human confirmed or nothing needs confirming
a non-interactive or unknown run cannot hold a human confirmation
PR body without agentive-review.u2 -> unknown run, no confirmation
U2.non_interactive: PR only, tier 2 -> the gate never auto-merges and asks a human (or blocks)
tier 0 or 1 auto-merge records the kill-switch scope it was checked against
profile ci: every posted finding is verified by RV7 (2026-10-27) and every blocking finding is confirmed
profile ci requires rv3 and rv4
profile precommit runs RV1, RV2, RV5 only
tier 2 in profile ci: RV8 records the ## Explainer check (required, ok or explainer_missing)
tier 0 and tier 1: ## Explainer is not required (F3 unchanged)
CHAIN: an intent or spec PR is always tier 2 with reason chain_approval (RV2 always_human; its merge is the human approval)
CHAIN: a chain order problem blocks: RV8 decision block (check failure) with reason chain_order

REPLYLINE: a confirmed important finding answered with wrong, intentional or not_important instead of a fix -> no auto-merge, human_required (or block) with reason finding_disputed, whoever wrote the reply

description: In profile ci every posted finding carries an RV7 verification and every blocking finding is confirmed important (refuted/inconclusive, nit and pre_existing findings never block). In profile precommit (RV1, RV2, RV5) RV3, RV4, RV7b, RV7, RV6 and RV8 do not run; rv3 and rv4 are absent. In profile ci RV7b and RV8 output are required; tier 2 never auto-merges; tier 1 auto-merge requires a computed RV7b score, tier1 mode on and no demotion; human_required concludes success with auto-merge off.
